messages:
tanvi: CI red on nightly-quant after merge to main. failing on gpu-node-12 (A30). logs show kernel panic XID 31 then oom.

sam: saw this locally on a quick run, could be driver/model-tool mismatch. @ci-bot can you attach full build log?

ci-bot: Build #8721 failed on runner-gpu-12. Log: https://ci.internal/8721

alex: paste of last 20 lines of container logs:
```
E CudaDriver: cuInit failed: unspecified launch failure
E Kernel: Xid 31 at 0x7f3a2b4
error: libcudnn.so.8: version `8.4.1' not found (required by /workspace/lib/libtorch_cuda.so)
OOM killer invoked: cgroup memory limit exceeded
```

tanvi: that `libcudnn` missing could indicate image mismatch to host driver. we bumped toolkit to 12.2 last week. mr fixes? (PR #834)

mike: I added a test that runs quantized warmup on nodes with older drivers -> that may trigger. Recommend pinning toolkit in rolling canary to 12.1 for now. re-run only on canary pool.

sam: can we quickly rerun this on a fresh A30 with driver 525? asking @infra-team

alex: +1 for canary rerun. also try `export TORCH_USE_CUDA_DSA=0` to disable DSA in case of uninitialized mem.

tanvi: potential workaround: in CI job add `--no-half` flag to the quant build. low perf but helps triage.

mike: bisect request: can we run bisect between commit abc123 (pre-toolkit bump) and def456 (post-bump)? need to know first bad commit.

sam: I'll schedule a targeted rerun and bisect tomorrow morning. for now marking as blocking release. @mike please add quick repro steps in the issue.

mike: done: steps pasted in issue #1427, includes docker run command and env vars.

tanvi: thanks. if rerun reproduces I'll open a driver-compat hotfix PR to pin base image.

ci-bot: Rerun scheduled by sam for pool=canary-gpu at 2026-05-12T08:00:00Z. Job 8732.

alex: if 8732 passes, we can roll forward. if fails, assign to eng-ml oncall.

sam: noted, will follow up with results here. :thumbsup:
